summary: This research study is testing how a new medicine called NNC0721-5186 works in women who are living with overweight or obesity. The study will look at safety and how the body handles the medicine compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug. In some groups, the study medicine will also be compared to semaglutide, an approved medicine used for weight management. There are 102 participants taking part in this Phase 1 trial.
